subject: Geografia

components.description_pt: Interpretar cartogramas contendo informações geográficas sobre África e Américas
components.description_en: Interpret cartograms containing geographic information about Africa and the Americas
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data representations to draw evidence-based conclusions about a phenomenon

components.description_en: Interpret geographic anamorphoses to extract spatial information about Africa and the Americas
